usedFor: Todoist holds your tasks and Perfex CRM holds your leads, so “New Task Created in Project” can run “Create Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Create Lead” in Perfex CRM
bestTemplate.why: A task added to a lead project becomes a lead in Perfex CRM, so quick notes turn into records.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” is polling, so leads appear after a scheduled check.
